name: ocel
label: OCEL 2.0
description: Imports OCEL 2.0 JSON logs (.json, .jsonocel) as tables in the package's storage space or as EKGs on Memgraph, shows the tables and a summary, decomposes the tables into an EKG (with the qualifiers on :CORR and the object-object relationships as :REL, through its step in ekg.build_steps) and exports them as OCEL 2.0 JSON.
author: SOUP
